_about: What a Pentakill Empower does for the team that the fight simulator can't see (champion_upgrades.py, team_extra). The simulator plays the champion's own fight, so healing and shielding on allies and team utility count as nothing there. Per champion and ability: cooldown = the ability's cooldown at full rank when the simulator kit leaves the ability out; allies = how many allies besides the caster an average cast heals or shields (its amount is the simulator kit's heal/shield, or heal/shield here when the kit leaves it out because only allies get it); util = what one cast is worth in seconds of crowd control on an enemy (a revive, team invulnerability, a spell shield, team speed), for effects with no heal, shield or crowd control to count. Amounts are the game's own ability values at full rank.
